name: base
description: Project foundations for Workers sites: tsconfig.json (astro strict + Cloudflare types), src/env.d.ts (public env vars), pnpm-workspace.yaml.
next: Workers sites only. Pages (static) sites do not need the Cloudflare module shims in env.d.ts; delete that block.

@cloudflare/workers-types stays a dev dependency for wrangler, but is deliberately NOT in tsconfig types: it merges into the DOM lib and breaks client code. For full binding types: pnpm exec wrangler types --include-runtime false.
